items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Fat Cat calls himself 'the poor man's Richard Gibson,' because of the Richard Gibson's jazz party in Denver held every year.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

And the Manassas jazz festival is a big once-a-year thing held in December. Fat Cat calls himself "the poor man's Richard Gibson," because of the Richard Gibson's jazz party in Denver held every year.

I just want to mention the title of the album that we've just been discussing, which is on the Fat Cat label, SCJ136,-- The title is a very appropriate one. It's "Maxine Sullivan, Queen of Song." And it has a delightful picture of you on the cover, too.
